manufacturers.meta.title: Robot manufacturers we work with | Professional Robotics
manufacturers.meta.description: We work with leading robotics manufacturers: Pudu, Gausium, Keenon, Hikrobot, Unitree and others. We select equipment for the task, tied to no single vendor.
manufacturers.hero.title: Manufacturers we work with.
manufacturers.hero.lead: We work with manufacturers directly, but we are not tied to any one of them. This is deliberate: an integrator tied to one vendor sells that vendor’s equipment even where it is not the best.
manufacturers.hero.text: Our main focus is strong Asian manufacturers: the best value for money, a wide choice and fast development. We keep several vendors in every area, so equipment can be replaced and you do not depend on a single supplier.

manufacturers.select.title: How we choose equipment.
manufacturers.select.lead: We are not tied to one vendor, so we choose equipment for your task and economics, not for our own catalog.
manufacturers.select.task.title: Task and economics
manufacturers.select.task.text: We start with the task and calculate payback. We choose what pays back for you, not what is in stock.
manufacturers.select.service.title: Service and support
manufacturers.select.service.text: We take equipment that can actually be maintained. Our own service network across Russia, work under an SLA.
manufacturers.select.swap.title: Several vendors per area
manufacturers.select.swap.text: We keep 2–5 manufacturers in every area. Equipment can be replaced, and no supplier becomes the only one.
manufacturers.select.platform.title: One platform for all equipment
manufacturers.select.platform.text: We connect robots of different brands to the Professional Robotics platform through manufacturer adapters: one map, reports and KPIs.
